fields.Name: T093 - Rename Conversation Persists
fields.Description: Exercises the conversation context-menu rename flow (input dialog + list update via renamedConversationId) — a distinct mutation path from message send or entity form edit.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the Chat application and wait for the workspace. In the left sidebar conversation list, hover a conversation and click its '...' (more options) menu, then choose 'Rename'. Enter a new distinctive name and confirm. Verify the conversation's label in the sidebar updates to the new name. If no conversations exist, first send a message to create one, then rename it. The renamed label appearing in the list is success. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The conversation '...' menu opens and offers a 'Rename' option
Entering a new name and confirming updates the conversation's label in the sidebar to the new value
The rename is reflected without a crash (the item stays in the list under its new name)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
